profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Sophos
profile.summary: Senior software engineer with extensive experience designing, developing, and supporting scalable, mission-critical applications and products, specializing in server-side Java development and middleware.  Experienced in full software development life cycle, including unit and integration testing using agile methods including XP and Scrum. Team player that thrives in collaborative environments where creativity and problem-solving are rewarded.  Fast learner that loves to explore and master new technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
As member of Cloudlets product development team, designed and developed RESTful APIs used by Akamai customers; integated REST webservices with back-end Akamai systems. See https://developer.akamai.com/api/luna/cloudlets/overview.html for complete details about the Cloudlets product and the APIs that we provided.

Designed and implemented integration testing framework used by development team to test the Cloudlets APIs. Framework improved the quality of our services and helped eliminate regression bugs. Framework used Jetty embedded server and HSQLDB embedded database along with SFTP servers and simulated HTTP back-end services.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Worked on Kindle Fire phone in Kindle Digital Products organization. Developed Android widgets used throughout Amazon applications on the phone, and an application to manage Amazon content including Books, Music, and Audible books.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Team lead for middleware application that communicated with cruise line reservation systems. Worked on web application used by numerous travel web sites to reserve cruises, primarily on front-end using Struts 2, JSPs, and jQuery.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a senior member of the Architecture team provided strategic direction for platform evolution along with design and development of projects related to overall platform performance and scalability. Worked on full cycle of development activities from architecture to design, development, unit testing, integration testing, and production support in a fast-paced environment with monthly iterations and production roll-outs.

•	Lead developer for design and development of caching tier using Oracle Coherence to offload 10+ million daily SQL queries to caching layer, resulting in 3X reduction in average response times, and 20X reduction in variance of response times.

•	Led team to redesign and reimplement Batch processing engine to increase throughput and scalability.
•	Enabled processing of arbitrarily large batch files. Largest tested file was 300MB containing 1,000,000 transactions. Reduced memory requirements to process max capacity file from 2.5GB to 20MB. Used StaX pull-parser to chunk inbound XML file into batches that were fed to Castor for conversion to Java objects.
•	Achieved 4X increase in throughput by rewriting transaction processing engine to use producer-consumer pattern, removing bottlenecks in threading code.
•	Enabled operations staff to control file processing speed by providing ability to throttle transaction processing to prevent overloading of back-end network connections to Visa and MasterCard.

•	Led effort to design and implement a real-time application monitoring and alerting framework for a highly distributed system. Evaluated third-party monitoring applications, performed proof-of-concept evaluations, and recommended product that was eventually purchased and implemented. Used JMX to instrument applications and created JSP-based dashboard to indicate system availability.

•	Wrote Apache 2.0 module to throttle inbound traffic from individual merchants to  prevent a single merchant from flooding system. written in C using Apache libraries.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on product development and professional services. On product development side, worked to automate deployment of service packages created with GUI developer tool. Integrated with Ant custom tasks. On professional services side, modified and extended web-based order fulfillment application. Webapp written using Struts, deployed on Tomcat server. Wrote both custom JSP pages and Struts actions for specific customers based on their needs.

positions.title: IT Software Systems Engineer
positions.description: Member of development team responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining an in-house publish and subscribe middleware system used internally by SunIT for guaranteed delivery of messages worldwide among internal business applications.  Developed in C++, Java, and JNI to integrate Java API on top of C++ infrastructure.  Re-implemented messaging API to create XML messages instead of proprietary message format, removing need for expensive translations at messaging gateways.
